policy.purpose: Protect Vietnamese review from literal or lossy zh-CN localization bridges when the game/worldbuilding uses a canonical player-facing concept.
policy.scope: Applied by translation review in addition to the normal term registry. This file is intentionally item-scoped and is not part of the global context hash, so adding a bridge rule only reopens matching entries.
policy.resolved_rule: A bridge-sensitive keep is resolved only when the accepted player-facing form is present and confidence is high.
policy.untrusted_rule: Known lossy zh-CN source titles stay deferred until a canonical Vietnamese rendering is curated from JP evidence.

terms.note: 金币 is the zh-CN localization bridge for the game's Monies currency. Do not literalize it as coins/gold coins in Vietnamese.
Player-facing Uma Musume terminology uses Cleat/Cleats for this resource. Avoid the literal horse-world calque 'móng ngựa'.
支援卡 is the zh-CN bridge for the player-facing Support Card term. Preserve Support Card instead of translating it literally into Vietnamese.
干劲 is the zh-CN bridge for the player-facing Mood state. Do not normalize it to generic Vietnamese wording such as 'Tinh thần' or 'Hứng khởi'.
